entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Anya Sharma. Order number is VF-8675309. It's for the VeloBand Pulse.

Thank you, Anya. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 17 days ago, on January 7th. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not for me. I just want my money back.

I understand. I do need to let you know that for our wearable devices like the VeloBand Pulse, we have a specific 10-day return window. Since we're on day 17, we are technically outside of that period.
Of course we are. So I'm just supposed to be out the money? Whatever.

I understand your frustration. The 10-day policy is typically quite firm due to hygiene protocols and device activation. However, we can sometimes make exceptions for extenuating circumstances. Was there a particular reason for the delay in reaching out to us?
It's been a bit of a month. There was a family emergency. My father had to go to the hospital for unexpected surgery and I haven't had a minute to think about anything else.

I am so sorry to hear that. I truly hope he's recovering well. That absolutely qualifies as an exception. We always make allowances for major life events, like a medical emergency or a sudden military deployment. I am more than happy to authorize a full refund for you as a one-time exception.

I've just processed the exception. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. You can just print that out, box the item up, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Additionally, I see you're a VIP member with us, and given the circumstances, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account for any future VeloFit gear.
Oh. Okay. I wasn't expecting that. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome, Anya. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and I wish your father a swift and easy recovery. Have a good rest of your day.
